claims.text: WALLDORF — SAP SE (NYSE: SAP) today announced it has completed the acquisition of TechWolf, provider of a leading AI work intelligence platform.
TechWolf is expected to become an intelligent core of the SAP SuccessFactors portfolio, supporting the company’s talent and work intelligence strategy.
TechWolf’s proprietary context graph will become SAP’s grounding layer for agent queries regarding work and skills planning and talent management.
This will make token usage more efficient, lowering the cost of deploying workforce agents and supporting Joule intelligence in AI-driven HR scenarios.
This press release was created with the assistance of artificial intelligence and has been reviewed by the editorial team.
